public_body: Southfield Redevelopment Authority Board Of Directors
overall: Violation found for failing to disclose in open session the specific parcel under negotiation for an executive session; the unlisted topic and the Purpose 6 claim were not violations. Board ordered to comply and release minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to list an anticipated executive session on its September 11 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: As an unanticipated topic, the Board was permitted to proceed with the executive session, despite the fact that the topic was not listed on the notice.

allegations.summary: Open-session purpose stated only as 'the Transfer of Land' without identifying the parcel under negotiation with the Navy.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide this additional detail to the public in open session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the executive session was improperly held under Purpose 6 because all redevelopment documents are public, so the Board had no negotiating position to protect.
allegations.key_passage: Because some parcels of land remain in the Navy's possession, there are still terms to negotiate with the Navy with respect to the transfer of those parcels.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Release the September 11 executive session minutes within 30 days of receipt of the determination.
